operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md: retain the exact source, private configuration and complete Evidence custody archive; restore into a fresh empty installation, compare records and attachment bytes, and verify owner sign-in before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
